register_platform_entry: register a new PlatformEntry with name, label, adapter_factory, and check_fn into the platform registry
unregister_platform: unregister a platform adapter entry from the registry by its name and return whether it existed
lookup_platform_entry: look up a registered PlatformEntry by name and return its metadata and factory callable
create_platform_adapter: create an adapter instance for a platform name by validating dependencies, config, and calling the factory
list_plugin_entries: list all plugin-registered platform entries from the registry to discover available plugin adapters
